props.name: value
props.description: Lit bars, 0 to 4. Fractions round to the nearest bar and values outside the range are clamped.

props.name: label
props.description: What the bars measure, first word of the accessible text — “Signal”, “Connection”, “Wi-Fi”.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Print the quality word beside the bars. The accessible text is there either way.

props.name: qualityLabels
props.description: Words for 0 to 4 bars, in order.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour by quality, or keep the bars in ink.
